// CASE ts_worker_member_op expect=pass
export async function a<T>(items: T[], width: number, client: { send: (item: T) => Promise<void> }) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await client.send(items[index]);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_comment_backtick_interp expect=pass
export async function b<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(/* see `${await x}` and ' */ items[index]);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_line_comment_with_block_open expect=pass
export async function c<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation( // don't /* await here
        items[index],
      );
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_block_comment_with_line expect=pass
export async function d<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(/* a // "b */ items[index]);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_results_prettier expect=pass
export async function e<T, R>(items: T[], width: number, operationWithAVeryLongDescriptiveName: (item: T) => Promise<R>) {
  const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        results[index] = await operationWithAVeryLongDescriptiveName(
          items[index]!, // it's never undefined
        );
      }
    }),
  );
  return results;
}
// CASE ts_worker_jsdoc_comment expect=pass
export async function f<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(/** it's the "item" — not `await` */ items[index]);
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_this_items expect=pass
export class Pool<T> {
  constructor(private items: T[], private op: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {}
  async run(width: number) {
    let next = 0;
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < this.items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        await this.op(this.items[index]);
      }
    }));
  }
}
// CASE ts_inorder_lone_backtick_comment expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(/* ` */ item);
  }
}
